reproduction_target: Targeted-amplicon genomic surveillance analysis of Anopheles gambiae s.l. insecticide resistance: the AmpSeeker snakemake pipeline (BCL->fastq, trim/QC, bwa alignment, coverage, bcftools variant calling, snpEff annotation) plus downstream custom Jupyter-notebook analyses (scikit-allel diplotype/heterozygosity + PCA population structure, XGBoost/SVM/AIM taxon assignment, statsmodels GLM genotype:phenotype association, XGBoost bioassay-mortality prediction, Plotly/Jupyter-Book results book). Wet-lab work (mosquito collection, WHO cone bioassays, DNA extraction, PCR1/PCR2 barcoding, MiSeq library prep/sequencing) and one-time primer/panel design (in-house-modified mprimer, AnoPrimer) are out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the 'Bioinformatic analysis' + 'Ancestry analysis', 'Population structure', 'Kdr analysis', 'Genotype:phenotype associations', and 'Predicting bioassay mortality' Methods prose. AmpSeeker is a named, public, MIT-licensed snakemake workflow (github.com/sanjaynagi/AmpSeeker) with per-rule conda env YAMLs under workflow/envs/ and a public results book (sanjaynagi.github.io/agvampir002-results/); code axis is set to 2 for pipeline/module steps because the executable artifact exists and is identifiable, even though the paper gives no formal code-availability statement, no repository URL in the DA section, and no run commit/release pin. Version axis follows exact pins found in prose (BCL-Convert v4.3.6, scikit-allel v1.3.7) or in the conda YAMLs (snpeff=5.1, plotly==5.24.1, pandas==2.1.4); tools left floating in the conda envs (fastp, fastqc, bwa, samtools, mosdepth, bcftools, xgboost, scikit-learn, anjl, statsmodels, jupyter-book, papermill) score version 0. STAGE-1 PROSE ONLY: workflow source not read line-by-line, no code executed; env_capture_class='n/a' for all steps. One-time primer/panel design tools (in-house-modified mprimer, AnoPrimer) and wet-lab steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: BCL->fastq conversion with BCL-Convert v4.3.6 (AmpSeeker snakemake rule)
Read trimming/quality assessment with fastp (Chen et al.); floating in conda env
Index-read quality assessment with FastQC; floating in conda env
Alignment to reference genome with bwa mem (Li & Durbin); floating in conda env
BAM indexing with samtools (conda spec samtools>=1.10, no exact pin)
Coverage assessment with mosdepth (conda spec mosdepth<0.3.11, no exact pin); IGV notebook read visualisation
Variant calling with bcftools mpileup (Danecek et al.); floating in conda env
Variant annotation with snpEff (conda pin snpeff=5.1)
Vgsc diplotype complete-linkage clustering (Manhattan distance) + per-sample heterozygosity with scikit-allel v1.3.7 (allel.GenotypeArray.is_het)
Population-structure PCA + Neighbour-joining trees on filtered SNPs (2389 SNPs) with scikit-allel v1.3.7 (NJ via anjl)
AIM-based taxon painting/assignment (chr3 + X AIMs, 0.5/1.5 thresholds) from published marker sets; custom notebook code
XGBoost taxon-classification model trained on 7363 Ag1000g WGS individuals (5-fold CV, hyperparameter ranges given); floating xgboost/scikit-learn
SVM taxon classifier on first 4 PCs (probability threshold 0.8) with scikit-learn; floating in conda env
Genotype:phenotype association: per-SNP binomial GLM (logit) + FDR correction with statsmodels (filters >20% missing, <2% MAF); floating in conda env
Bioassay-mortality prediction with XGBoost (210 QC SNPs, 5-fold CV, GridSearchCV hyperparameter grid given, 'best params underlined'); floating xgboost/scikit-learn
Notebook execution (papermill) + interactive results book assembly with Plotly (conda ==5.24.1) and Jupyter Book (unpinned)

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: Up to 3/16 (19%) reach the stage1 RI ceiling: AmpSeeker is a public, MIT-licensed snakemake workflow (github.com/sanjaynagi/AmpSeeker) with per-rule conda env YAMLs, and raw reads are deposited in SRA (PRJNA1207724), so steps whose primary tool carries an exact version pin — snpEff 5.1 (conda) and scikit-allel v1.3.7 (prose, used for Vgsc diplotype/heterozygosity and PCA) — cap at RI. The other 13 steps cap at NI: their primary tools are floating in the conda envs (fastp, fastqc, bwa, samtools, mosdepth, bcftools, xgboost, scikit-learn, anjl, statsmodels, jupyter-book, papermill) or their input (raw BCL) is not deposited (only reads/fastq are in SRA). No lockfile/container is present so full software-environment closure is unverified; capture_claim is exact_pins_partial and this is a legitimate stage2 candidate (read the conda envs / snakemake rules to confirm exact resolved versions).
headline.coverage: 16 computational steps assessed from the AmpSeeker 'Bioinformatic analysis' + downstream ML/stats Methods prose; 6 wet-lab steps counted (W) out of computational-reproduction scope; one-time primer/panel design (in-house-modified mprimer, AnoPrimer) excluded from C. Code repo (AmpSeeker) 200 OK, results book (agvampir002-results) 200 OK, SRA BioProject PRJNA1207724 200 OK.

gaps.where: Software environment for the AmpSeeker pipeline + custom notebooks (all C-steps)
gaps.missing: No lockfile (conda-lock/pixi.lock), container image, or container digest is provided. The public repo ships per-rule conda env YAMLs (workflow/envs/*.yaml) but most dependencies are floating (fastp, fastqc, bwa, samtools>=1.10, mosdepth<0.3.11, bcftools, xgboost, scikit-learn, anjl, statsmodels, jupyter-book, papermill); only a minority are exactly pinned (snpeff=5.1, plotly==5.24.1, pandas==2.1.4, python bounds). No resolved software environment is captured for the specific run.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish a resolved lock (conda-lock / pixi.lock) or a container digest for the exact run, so floating conda specs resolve to reproducible versions.

gaps.missing: The paper names AmpSeeker and points to Supplementary Text 3 and the results book, but gives no formal code-availability statement, no repository URL in the Data availability section, and no commit hash / release tag identifying the exact pipeline version used. gaps.how_to_close: Add a code-availability statement citing github.com/sanjaynagi/AmpSeeker (and the agvampir002-results repo) with the exact commit/release and a Zenodo DOI for the frozen version used.
